title: Young Zoog

[[Image:YoungZoog.png|thumb]]
'''Young Zoog''' is an [[ally]].  It first appears in the [[Kingsport Horror]] expansion. It can be gained through an encounter in [[The Dreamlands]], through [[:Image:Gate96.png|a green Gate card]].

==Card info==
*+1 [[Lore]]
*+1 [[Speed]]
*+1 [[Will]]

Discard if you gain [[Foolishness]] as an Ally.

==Mythos Source==
The Zoogs appear in Lovecraft's ''The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath''. They are small brown creatures who live in the woods and plan to go to war with the cats of Ulthar.
